method: Read-only exact source/delta review; no Node/import, Auth, SMTP, DB query, browser or process action by reviewer. Runtime release remains coordinator responsibility.
observations: Existing exact launcher/config/native-target pins remain; wrapped MachO executable and runtime profile are rehashed, PID/listener/executable ownership is checked before/after. DSN remains pinned to the new UUID database on127.0.0.1:55322, with only exact sslmode=disable permitted.

Continuation requires a private0600 checkpoint belonging to the same controlled identity, unchanged original password, no previous dispatched password update, prior real recovery200, failed report/sourceStable/preserved protected rows and exact Native target binding. Current unconsumed Auth recovery token must equal the retained checkpoint token.

The original private MIME/receipt is reused with recipient/byte-count/SHA verification; SMTP accepted count remains exactly1 at continuation. No second recovery request or new replacement password is created in resume branch.

MIME parser accepts only the frozen Native-configured known path /verify or /auth/v1/verify, exact loopback origin and recovery type. The flow POSTs the recovered hash to actual Auth API; it does not claim email-link clicking, frontend routing or a browser password-reset form.

Real password change/old denial/new acceptance/token reuse denial are still independent runtime assertions. Finally restores original password even after uncertain update dispatch; administrative repair is isolated cleanup only and cannot prove normal recovery succeeded.
New read-only closure checks count only known newly owned Auth session IDs and their unrevoked refresh grants;0/0 is required. No global logout or unrelated-session revocation.

Issued passwords/tokens and MIME remain in deliberate private files; ordinary-log exact-value scan is in memory and publishes no values. Protected original Auth/public data and fixture public data are compared at closure.
limits: Static approval is not proof of runtime recovery completion.
The retained earlier preflight/parser failures must remain unchanged.
Local SMTP is an explicit transport double; no real external email delivery, password-reset UI, complete Auth restoration or browser acceptance.
